verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State portal collects and publishes filer data, and it sells data and image subscriptions, so a privacy-posture question about AI-training use of that data is a fair one to ask. The evidence pack contains no opt-out, policy, or setting that keeps user data out of AI model training. The Radware bot-manager CAPTCHA on the front door is an anti-scraping control, not a user-facing training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
